data.raw_text:
Philippines are seeking an investigation on popular games (in Asia; Free Fire, Mobile Legend Bang Bang) especially Minecraft and Roblox. These game are being investigated by the authorities for child safety concerns.

The senators in Philippines are seeking to implement "age verification (face ID and/or ID-Government verification) protocols and safety standard" on the online platforms.

Risa Hontiveros (Philippines Senator) said: "Instead of banning platforms, the policymakers should pursue risk-based safety measures, alongside efforts to improve digital literacy and promote responsible gaming among young users."
